svg.aria-label: A recording-style demo of the cloudmail CLI and MCP server. In a terminal, cloudmail mail send is typed; the send is held for approval and nothing is sent. cloudmail approval wait then waits. An agent connected over MCP calls search_emails, get_thread and draft_reply, and its send_reply returns pending_approval. Both messages sit in Pending approval in cloudmail; a person opens the first, clicks Approve and send, and the terminal prints approved and sent.
